verdict.rationale: No evidence describes a mechanism to cancel or correct a payroll run after submission but before employees are paid; docs only mention comparing runs before final approval (pre-submission) and reviewing timesheets, not post-submission correction. The one real-world incident (comm-1) shows a payroll error was not caught/corrected in time, with employees left unpaid on schedule, undermining any implied 'fix before pay' capability rather than confirming it.
